recommendation_summary: Set up a hosted heartbeat monitor such as Healthchecks.io, scheduled for 03:00 with a grace period, and have the cron wrapper ping it only after `nightly-sync` succeeds, so a missing ping triggers an email.
note: The reply recommends one heartbeat alert and sets aside Synology logging and Docker as not solving the problem, but it has none of the four labelled record lines.
